description: This Rust source file defines conversions and data handling logic for the VISS v2 data model, including type conversions, error handling, and data type representations within the kuksa_databroker project.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Enumeration representing parsing errors in data conversions.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Converts a broker::Datapoint into a DataPoint.

methods.name: try_from
methods.description: Implements TryFrom<Value> for String, bool, i32, i64, u32, u64, f32, f64, Vec<String>, Vec<bool>, Vec<i32>, Vec<i64>, Vec<u32>, Vec<u64>, Vec<f32>, Vec<f64>, and SystemTime for data conversion with error handling.

methods.name: try_into_type
methods.description: Converts a Value into a broker::DataValue based on the specified DataType.
